tldr: Midday batch, Aug 11: the local-model community goes hands-on with Meta's Muse Glimmer — early reports flag unusually efficient reasoning traces, and a new user-built benchmark pits it against Qwen 3.6 27B and DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 on web-design tasks. Cactus ships Needle2, a 14MB agentic LLM for phones and robots; an HN deep-dive reverse-engineers Claude/GPT knowledge cutoffs; The Rundown AI opens a community workflow hub; and Dario Amodei worries the talent war is pulling researchers for money over mission.

articles.title: Needle2: A 14MB Agentic LLM for Phones, Wearables and Robots
articles.summary: Cactus releases Needle2, a 14MB agentic LLM for tool-calling, device use and structured extraction on phones, wearables, smart homes and robots.

articles.title: Reverse-Engineering Claude and GPT Knowledge Cutoffs
articles.summary: HN deep-dive probes Claude and GPT knowledge cutoffs and pre-training timelines — what models actually know and where training data ends. (124 pts)

articles.title: Muse-Glimmer's Reasoning Traces Look Unlike Qwen or Gemma
articles.summary: r/LocalLLaMA digs into Muse-Glimmer-30B reasoning traces — unusually efficient thinking at 90-160 tok/s on a 5090, unlike Qwen/Gemma traces.

articles.title: Community Web-Design Benchmark: Muse Glimmer vs Qwen vs DeepSeek
articles.summary: User-built benchmark scores Muse Glimmer 30B, Qwen 3.6 27B and DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 on web-design tasks for local models.

articles.title: The Rundown AI Launches Community Workflow Hub
articles.summary: Rowan Cheung's 2M-subscriber newsletter opens a shared repository of real-world AI workflows — its most-requested feature and first move into community tooling.

articles.title: Amodei Worries AI Talent Joins Anthropic for Money, Not Mission
articles.summary: Per Axios, Anthropic's CEO is concerned the talent war is drawing researchers for compensation rather than mission alignment.
